name: SunBlock
source:
Your loving partner Nash decides to drag you to Australia because of some supposed creature sightings. While there some bullies give you both some trouble leading to Nash deciding to protect you in Nash's own oddly endearing way.

[From [url=https://cherryghost.itch.io/sunblock]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的爱人纳什决定把你拖到澳大利亚，因为看到了一些所谓的生物。虽然有些恶霸给你们俩带来了一些麻烦，导致纳什决定以纳什自己奇怪可爱的方式保护你们。

[来自[url=https://cherryghost.itch.io/sunblock]itch.io[/url]]
